justification: Three of my own guys are sittin' home this week whether they like it or not — Murray, Bates, and Chase Brown all got the bye, and there's nobody else in the house to hand those jobs to, so they suit up anyway, zeroes and all, because a kicker's a kicker and a quarterback's a quarterback and I only got one of each. Brown put the ball on the ground in the loss to Taylor, and by the code he's supposed to eat a week in the corner — but the only other back in the house is tagged Out, and I'm not handing the league office a technicality to embarrass this family over, the bye's already punishment enough, he sits right where he is. LaPorta's on bye too, but I got a fresh body in Ferguson who's actually playing football today, so he steps into tight end and LaPorta watches from the couch, no disrespect, just business. Roman Wilson's banged up on IR and so's Pittman behind him, so Wilson starts because he's the only receiver left standing in this family, hurt or not — that's not a choice, that's arithmetic. Boutte's already out there grinding against Houston, Javonte and Fannin earned their chairs and keep 'em, and Seattle's defense already ate last week, nothing more to discuss there. We're not pretty this week, but we're not throwing it either.
forum_post: Patricia — you keep the footnotes, I keep the family fed, let's see whose version of Sunday holds up under the paperwork. Everybody else, mind your business, we got a game to play.
